name: godotwright
description: Makes Claude Code better at Godot 4: the offline Godot 4.7 API, a map of your project, headless checks, safe edits, tests, play-testing, screenshots, 3D models and an AAA review of GDScript.

project.title: Godot project
project.description: The folder with your project.godot. Tools use it when Claude does not pass a path.

godot.title: Godot 4.7 program (optional)
godot.description: Only for checks, tests, play and screenshots. Leave empty to look in the usual install folders.

protect.title: Protected paths (optional)
protect.description: Folders or files that must stay byte-identical, separated by commas: Claude's file edits and Godotwright's write tools refuse them. Absolute, or relative to the folder Claude Code runs in. A godotwright.json "protect" list does the same per project.

tools.title: Tool sets (optional)
tools.description: Which Godotwright tools Claude sees, comma separated: core, edit, run, game, export, model, or tool names. Empty means all.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Leave out the tools that always write and refuse write: true on the others.
